items.title: Functoriality of the identification of the cohomology of O_{P^n_R}(d): the identifications of Equation (identify) are compatible with base change along ring maps R -> R', and for f in R[T_0,...,T_n] homogeneous of degree m the map on cohomology induced by multiplication by f : O(d) -> O(d+m) is multiplication by f on H^0 and the contragredient of multiplication by f from (R[T])_{-n-1-(d+m)} to (R[T])_{-n-1-d} on H^n.

items.difficulty_reason: The whole proof is in the span: for base change, the standard covering U' of P^n_{R'} is the pullback of U, giving a map of Cech complexes gamma compatible with cohomology via Cohomology functoriality-cech, and compatibility with the identifications is verified by observing that basis elements of the Cech complex over R map to the corresponding basis elements over R'. For the multiplication statement, additivity and functoriality reduce to f in R or f = T_i; scalars act as R-module structure on every complex in sight; for T_i the argument decomposes the Cech complex as a direct sum over exponent vectors e with sum e_i = d of subcomplexes C^bullet(e) (notation of lemma-cohomology-projective-space-over-ring), shows multiplication by T_i maps C^bullet(e) to C^bullet(e + b_i), hence the H^n summand with e_i < 0 to the summand for e + b_i (zero once the coordinate becomes nonnegative), and identifies this with the contragredient action on the graded pieces.
